Speech to text, text to speech and text analysis.

## API key

1. Open [console.deepgram.com](https://console.deepgram.com/) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from the Deepgram Console.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add deepgram
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  deepgram: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Deepgram's [API](https://developers.deepgram.com/reference/deepgram-api-overview) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show deepgram` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Nova-3 pre-recorded $0.0043 per audio minute (pay as you go); Aura-2 speech $0.030 per 1k characters; $200 free credit.

**Rate limits:** Concurrency per project on pay as you go: 50 pre-recorded transcriptions, 15 text-to-speech requests.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Deepgram).
